Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Department: AI Platform
Location: Bengaluru · Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
Build reliable NLP products that help teams understand customer conversations. Work with an experienced applied AI group and ship useful features to production.

Responsibilities
- Design and deploy machine learning pipelines with Python and PyTorch.
- Collaborate with data engineering and product teams.

Required Qualifications
- Must have 3+ years of experience building NLP applications.
- Strong Python, SQL, and Postgres skills.
- AWS certification required.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Data Science.

Preferred Qualifications
- Kubernetes and ReactJS experience is nice to have.
- Excellent communication skills are a plus.

Benefits
- Health insurance
- Paid leave
- Learning budget
